title: Short Prompts Save AI Tokens: Try This Prompt Trick
description:
Long prompts get long, costly answers. 💸

✅ Name the task in a few words
✅ Cap the answer: "Reply in 3 lines."
✅ Count the words with a few lines of C#: 12 words down to 6

Day 6 of Token Saver! Next up, Day 7: Point to Files, Don't Paste.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to spend fewer tokens with AI.

#shorts #ai #aitools #promptengineering #chatgpt #claudecode #coding #llm
comment: Short or long prompts: which do you write? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: end your prompt with a limit like "Reply in 3 lines." so the answer stays short too.
